name: Area 47
kurzbeschreibung: Area 47 at the gateway to the Ötztal Valley is Austria's premier outdoor adventure park, renowned for its giant Water AREA, wakeboard lake, whitewater rafting, and canyoning.
preis: Water AREA admission charges apply; guided outdoor river and climbing tours booked separately
oeffnungszeiten: Seasonal operations late April through early October; open daily
beschreibung:
Überblick

Located on the 47th parallel north at the entrance of the Ötztal Valley, Area 47 stands as Austria's largest and most exhilarating outdoor adventure theme park, celebrated internationally by action enthusiasts and adventure seekers. Spanning approximately 9.5 hectares at the confluence of the glacial Ötztaler Ache and the Inn River, the venue combines raw alpine nature with world-class adrenaline rushes. The heart of the park is the legendary 'Water AREA', a 20,000-square-metre swimming lake featuring towering extreme water slides, a 27-metre-high cliff diving platform, hydro cannon launchers, and the world-famous blobbing cushion. Water sports fans can also carve waves on the cutting-edge wakeboard cable park on its dedicated lake. Beyond aquatic thrills, Area 47 serves as Europe's premier adventure base for guided whitewater rafting through the turbulent rapids of the Imst Gorge, canyoning expeditions into deep alpine ravines, and a high-ropes obstacle course suspended beneath a 27-metre road bridge.

Route & Anforderungen

Experiences cater to leisure lake bathers as well as extreme sports thrill-seekers. Confident swimming ability is strictly mandatory for the Water AREA; safety lifejackets are distributed free of charge on site. Children aged 6 and above can splash in designated shallow shore areas, while high-speed slides and cliff-diving towers have age restrictions of 12 or 16 years. For guided wilderness expeditions like canyoning or whitewater rafting, commercial wetsuits, safety helmets, and buoyancy vests are provided in full; participants need only bring swimwear, a towel, and standard physical fitness.

Besuch & Anreise

Area 47 is located at the threshold of the Ötztal Valley near the village of Roppen. Drivers take motorway A12 (exit Ötztal) and follow clear regional signs toward Roppen and Area 47. Over 500 complimentary parking spaces are available for cars and motorcycles. Rail travelers arrive at Bahnhof Ötztal station; during the summer season, regular shuttle buses and local transit connect the station directly to the adventure park entrance, or visitors can take a pleasant 20-minute signposted walk along the river trail.

Tipps

Do not miss experiencing the giant blobbing cushion in the Water AREA: jumping onto the inflatable airbag launches your companion high into the sky before a refreshing splashdown. For whitewater rafting and canyoning tours, book your time slots well in advance online, as weekend departures frequently sell out weeks ahead during midsummer.
